rules.description: Caps Lock: hold as Control, tap as Caps Lock
Right Cmd/Ctrl + WM keys -> ctrl+alt (AeroSpace/Hammerspoon); all other combos stay native

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "Google Chrome" to click (first menu item of menu "Bookmarks" of menu bar item "Bookmarks" of menu bar 1 whose name begins with "Bookmark This Tab")'

rules.description: Chrome: Ctrl-T open new tab (Ctrl-Shift-T reopen closed tab)
Chrome: Caps-H/L history and Caps-number tab selection

to.shell_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 1'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 2'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 3'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 4'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 5'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 6'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 7'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 8'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to 9'
osascript -e 'tell application "Google Chrome" to set active tab index of front window to (count tabs of front window)'
